verdict.rationale: Code lives in standard Git repositories, which are portable and open [gitlab-docs-7]. Community advocates note that the open-source core lets users run their own instance or fork it, which reduces lock-in [gitlab-comm-6-refresh-8da979844ef3570e]. Beyond repositories, the pack documents no first-party export feature for issues, merge requests, or other project data. The REST API [gitlab-docs-12] is only a building block, and the cited importer moves data into GitLab, not out of it. missing for 10: documented full-account/project export feature, open-format export of issues/MRs/CI data, migration-out guidance, independent corroboration of leaving with all data.
